messages:
adele: quick check — planning to flip flash_attn_v2 + spec_decoding_async for the low-latency runtime tomorrow. proposing staged canary, need ops/QA signoff
jesse: +1. what's the canary audience and rollback criteria?
adele: plan: 1) staging smoke tonight. 2) prod canary 1% first 2hr, then 5% the next 4hr if stable.
priya: add guardrails: latency p99 increase > 30ms OR token error rate > 0.5% => immediate rollback
omar: for audience: use account_id % 100 == 42 for 1% seed, then <=5 for 5%. also exclude dedicated customers via label.
jesse: make sure kernel_fallback map is set so if flash_attn fails we route to flash_attn_v1 or baseline, and spec_decoding falls back to spec_decode_off
adele: config snippet:
```
flags:
  flash_attn_v2: on
  spec_decoding_async:
    audience: "modulo:100:<=1"
  kv_cache_prefetch:
    enabled: true
rollout:
  p0: 1%
  p1: 5%
guardrails:
  p99_ms_delta: 30
  error_rate_pct: 0.5
```
priya: can we tag this rollout: `kernel/flashattn/specdec/2026-03-17` so we can filter in console?
omar: yes, and add `rollback_reason` metrics to the rollout trace
jesse: i'll open the PR with the flag definitions + rollout job, pinging @adele for review
adele: thanks — quick checklist: PR, staging smoke, telemetry dashboards (latency, errors, fallback-rate), ops ready to abort, tag in console. once staged ok i'll kick prod canary
deploy-bot: reminder: schedule maintenance window? we probably don't need one for 1% but ops asked for 4h window
priya: ops ok without full window but will be on-call for first 6h
adele: ok locking times: staging smoke 21:00 UTC today, prod start 02:00 UTC tomorrow. I'll push PR in ~30m
jesse: noted. I'll add kernel fallback unit tests and a quick perf run
deploy-bot: staged smoke passed at 21:12 UTC — deploy job 3421 succeeded, no errors
adele: great — tagging this thread with rollout tag and moving checklist to the playbook
omar: one more — add KV cache prefetch threshold to avoid evict storms: prefetch_batch_size=8, max_prefetch_inflight=64
priya: added to PR comments
adele: awesome. thanks team :thumbsup:
